npc.quest.scavenger.stages.0.text.2: You see, my grandmother asked me to bring her some flowers
npc.quest.scavenger.stages.0.text.3: and blueberries, and some mushrooms, and some coal, and some logs
npc.quest.scavenger.stages.0.text.4: and some tomatoes, and some potatoes, and some string, and some strawberries
npc.quest.scavenger.stages.0.text.5: anyway, I won't have you bring all that.
npc.quest.scavenger.stages.0.text.6: Can you go check on my grandma first, she's probably in one of those houses
npc.quest.scavenger.stages.0.text.7: I'm not sure, try looking around.
npc.quest.scavenger.stages.0.completedTe: Look through the houses for my grandma and see what she needs.
npc.quest.scavenger.stages.1.text.0: Oh hello, please don't mind the random tent in my house.
npc.quest.scavenger.stages.1.text.1: I've been waiting for my granddaughter to bring me some ingredients
npc.quest.scavenger.stages.1.text.2: but that was months ago. Do you think you can help me out?
npc.quest.scavenger.stages.1.text.3: I only ask that you bring me 2 tomatoes, 2 strawberries, and a piece of string.
npc.quest.scavenger.stages.1.text.4: I will grant you a reward if you do.
npc.quest.scavenger.stages.1.text.5: You can find those ingredients throughout the world, just look around.
npc.quest.scavenger.stages.1.completedTe: Please bring me 2 tomatoes, 2 strawberries, and a piece of string.
npc.quest.scavenger.stages.2.hasItemText: Thank you so much young one. You're so helpful.
Here, take this gold as a reward for your troubles.
npc.quest.scientistspotion.stages.0.text: Hey there kid, do you wanna help me with something?
Listen, I need a bunch of ingredients in order to create a potion
this is the perfect potion. It'll make you stronger, faster, and smarter
Listen, if you help me out I'll let you in on a little secret
I'll teach you how to make potions all by yourself.
Heck, I'll even give you access to all my cauldr- I mean,
my scientific equipment throughout the world.
Okay so what I need is you to make me one of my special potions.
npc.quest.seaactivities.stages.0.text.1: THE EVIL SEA CUCUMBER STOLE MY MONEY
npc.quest.seaactivities.stages.0.text.3: PLEASE HE WENT SOMEWHERE SOUTH OF HERE
npc.quest.seaactivities.stages.0.text.4: FIND HIM PLEASE AND GET MY MONEY BACK!
npc.quest.seaactivities.stages.1.text.0: Wait why are you here in my house?
npc.quest.seaactivities.stages.1.text.1: Is it about that stupid sponge?
npc.quest.seaactivities.stages.1.text.2: Listen man, I only took his money because he owed me
npc.quest.seaactivities.stages.1.text.3: a lot of money for the last 10 years.
npc.quest.seaactivities.stages.1.text.5: Now get out of my house.
npc.quest.seaactivities.stages.1.complet: I said I'm not giving it back, now beat it.
npc.quest.seaactivities.stages.2.text.0: Did you get my money back?
npc.quest.seaactivities.stages.2.text.1: He doesn't want to give it back?
npc.quest.seaactivities.stages.2.text.2: Tell that stupid cucumber to give it back or else!
npc.quest.seaactivities.stages.2.complet: Go tell him to give me my money back!
npc.quest.seaactivities.stages.3.text.0: Okay you know what, I asked you to leave my house
npc.quest.seaactivities.stages.3.text.1: if you don't want to do that, then I'll have to fight you.
npc.quest.seaactivities.stages.3.text.2: I'll meet you in my personal arena then.
npc.quest.seaactivities.stages.3.complet: Go through the door and fight me fair and square!
npc.quest.seaactivities.stages.5.text.0: All right all right. You win, I'll give that stupid sponge his gold.
npc.quest.seaactivities.stages.5.text.1: Here, now get out of here and leave me alone.
npc.quest.seaactivities.stages.6.hasItem: Thank you adventurer! With this gold I can finally buy a new house!
Just you look at me, Mr. Sponge, homeowner!
npc.quest.sorcery.stages.0.text.0: Oh dear adventurer, it's you! One of the thousands
npc.quest.sorcery.stages.0.text.1: I've trained and definitely not someone I don't remember.
npc.quest.sorcery.stages.0.text.2: Listen, I'm on vacation here and was relaxing on the beach
npc.quest.sorcery.stages.0.text.3: when all of the sudden I lost my entire magic contrband!
npc.quest.sorcery.stages.0.text.4: I can't run a business if I don't have my equipment.
npc.quest.sorcery.stages.0.text.5: Tell you what, if you bring me back 3 magic beads, I'll
npc.quest.sorcery.stages.0.text.6: grant you access to my shop!
npc.quest.sorcery.stages.0.completedText: If I recall correctly, some big macho crab took it
and then retreated in a cave west of here.
npc.quest.sorcery.stages.1.hasItemText.0: Perfect, just perfect. These will surely be great.
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.0.text.0: Oh, hello! Welcome! Click on me again!
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.0.text.1: You're getting the hang of it, keep clicking.
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.0.text.2: Perfect, seems like you get the gist of it.
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.0.text.3: I am the coder, I created this world, and, well, you.
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.0.text.4: Listen, to me you are just a more sophisticated AI.
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.0.text.5: So I'm gonna need you to get used to this world and help me out.
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.0.text.6: You see, I created these previous AIs, but they went rogue.
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.0.text.7: They are now trying to destroy this world.
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.0.text.8: So, I created you in order to stop them and save us all.
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.0.text.9: Before we get to any of that, we need to teach you some of the basics.
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.0.text.10: You can move around by clicking, or using WASD keys, or arrow keys.
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.0.text.11: Make sure you talk to everyone you meet fully, you never know what you might learn.
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.0.text.12: Whenever you feel like you're ready, head on outside and talk to the guard.
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.0.completedTex: Whenever you are ready, head outside and talk to the guard.
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.2.text.1: Welcome to the world of PixelHero.
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.2.text.2: I'm here to teach you about skills and combat.
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.2.text.3: Skills are activities that allow you to collect items and gain experience.
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.2.text.4: You can use the experience to discover new areas and engage in more complex tasks.
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.2.text.5: Before we get to any combat-related skills, I want you to cut two trees for me.
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.2.text.6: Here, take this axe, open your inventory, and equip it.
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.2.completedTex: Go on, cut two trees for me.
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.4.text.0: Okay perfect, you can use logs to make sticks.
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.4.text.1: Take this knife and use it to fletch some sticks.
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.4.text.2: Simply click on the item in your inventory and select the interact option.
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.4.completedTex: Go on, fletch the logs into sticks for me.
Awesome, just bear with me a little longer.
I know it's boring but I am obligated to teach you this.
Now take this fishing pole and go catch two shrimps for me.
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.5.completedTex: Go on, catch two shrimps for me.
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.7.text.0: Great, one more thing and we're done with the boring stuff.
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.7.text.1: It's as much of a chore for me as it is for you so don't worry.
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.7.text.2: Go click on that cooking pot and cook these shrimps for me.
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.7.completedTex: Go on, cook the shrimps for me.
Awesome, you're done with the boring stuff.
Head down that suspicious ladder to the left and meet me in the cave.
Don't question it, just trust me.
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.8.completedTex: Head down the ladder and meet me in the cave.
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.10.text.0: Okay, now listen closely. Our budget is running low.
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.10.text.1: So we need to hurry this up. I have to teach you about combat.
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.10.text.2: Because of said budget, I can only give the very basics.
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.10.text.3: Here is a copper sword, I want you to slay 5 rats for me.
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.10.completedTe: Go on, slay 3 rats for me.
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.12.text.0: Wow I actually didn't expect you to be competent.
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.12.text.1: You see how slow that was? That's because you don't have any fancy equipments.
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.12.text.2: Once you're out of here you'll be able to get better equipments.
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.12.text.3: Anyway, last thing I can teach you within my curriculum is archery.
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.12.text.4: For the sake of this tutorial, you will not need to equip any arrows.
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.12.text.5: Plus it saves us a ton of money for the arrows we don't have to give you.
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.12.text.6: So anyway, I want you to kill 2 crabs with this bow.
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.12.completedTe: Go on, kill 2 crabs for me.
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.14.text.0: That will be all. The rest is up to you to discover.
npc.quest.tutorial.stages.14.text.1: You may leave the tutorial by going through the portal.
npc.quest.anvilsechoes.door.0: Hey, don't go in there, it's dangerous!
npc.achievement.ratinfestation.dialogueH: Please help me with these rats!
If you slay 20 of them, I'll su-
npc.achievement.ratinfestation.dialogueS: Please, those rats are really annoying!
npc.achievement.boxingman.dialogueHidden: Hey there, you look like you can take a punch!
I'm looking for someone to beat up some stuff for me.
If you go and beat up 25 snakes, I have a special reward for you!
npc.achievement.boxingman.dialogueStarte: I'll show you something special if you do!
npc.achievement.crabproblem.dialogueHidd: Listen, could you lend me a hand?
I see you're pretty good with the killing stuff.
npc.achievement.crabproblem.dialogueStar: C'mon man, please kill me 10 crabs.
npc.achievement.zombielovers.dialogueHid: You! Please, you need to help me!
My boyfriend went down in that mine below and got stuck!
He looks just like one of those zombies!
Slay 20 of them just to make sure they're not my boyfriend.
What? I gotta give you a task, isn't that why you talked to me?
